periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Approximately 45 degrees relative to the horizontal facial axis, angled downward toward the rostrum.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval with the major axis approximately twice the length of the minor axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced tapering at the ventral-rostral margin, creating a non-symmetrical teardrop profile.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Shallow U-shape curve along the posterior margin with a broad, relatively flat profile at the dorsal midline.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Occupies approximately 33% of the visible vertical height of the lateral torso.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: The inter-ear gap is approximately 1.5 times the width of an individual pinna.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Uniformly rounded semi-circular arcs along the superior boundary.
